introHtml: Adult hand sanitizer means full-size bottles and practical formats designed for everyday use by grown-ups. Unlike kid-focused options, these products offer standard alcohol concentrations and professional packaging that fits comfortably in an office, facility, or trade show setting. Choose from 1 oz squirt bottles, 2 oz antibacterial pumps, or credit card shaped sprays that slip into a pocket or bag. Custom imprint your logo on the label or sleeve for effective brand exposure every time someone reaches for a clean.
